description: This file contains utility functions for managing and restoring state dictionaries in PyTorch's FX graph modules, specifically for tracing and exporting models. It includes functions to extract underlying modules, clear parameters and buffers, and restore state dicts to match original modules, ensuring correct Fully Qualified Names (FQNs) and graph node updates.

methods.name: _get_underlying_module
methods.description: Extracts the underlying nn.Module from either a module or a bound method.

methods.name: _clear_traced_params_buffers
methods.description: Removes specified parameters and buffers from a traced module, reassigning them as attributes to prevent them from appearing in the state dict.

methods.name: _restore_state_dict
methods.description: Restores the state dict of a traced FX module to match the original module, updating parameter and buffer names, and graph nodes to ensure consistency with the original module structure.
